scope: Standing core and attached galleries of the Uganda National Museum on Kiira Road, including the 1954 Ernst May and William Bousted building and octagonal Natural History Gallery.
era: Standing museum core and recorded gallery additions, before the current renovation.

review.notes: Checked the published Qualla gallery first and used no photographs or graphic reference material. The conservation team’s written survey, official records, named footprint and original terrain provide the controls.
